newsitem.title: FRANCE: CNP needs 3 billion Ffr capital hike - French CDC.
newsitem.headline: CNP needs 3 billion Ffr capital hike - French CDC.

text.p: French insurer CNP, which is on the government privatisation list, will need a capital increase to the tune of three billion francs and state bank CDC is willing to inject fresh money, CDC chairman Philippe Lagayette said.
Lagayette also said in the newspaper interview in La Tribune daily that CNP would remain tied to the Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC) even if the government sold its stake in the insurer.
"CNP is in the group and will stay even if the state sells its shares," he said.
"It's a subsidiary which is doing well but it will need a capital increase of around three billion francs. The CDC is ready to inject fresh funds to ensure its development," he added.
CNP is 42 percent-owned by the state, with 30 percent in the hands of the CDC, 17.5 percent with La Poste and 10 percent with the Caisses d'Epargne savings bank group.
